title: Power Apps: model-driven app AI settings consolidated in Copilot hub and Maker Studio
summary: Hold: the table incorrectly says automation is not documented for settings covered by Microsoft's Environment Management Settings API. The combined search-and-chart control also cites a page that documents only search, and the statement that edit roles are unstated overlooks the documented Power Platform administrator role for row summaries.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to consolidate model-driven app AI settings across Maker Studio and the Power Platform admin center.
claims.quote: Consolidated AI settings make it easier for makers and admins to find and manage AI capabilities for model-driven apps across two complementary surfaces.

claims.claim: The roadmap adds a top-level Copilot and AI tab to the Settings dialog in the model app form designer.
claims.quote: In Maker Studio, the Settings dialog in the model app form designer adds a new top-level Copilot and AI tab.

claims.claim: The planned maker tab gathers the app's available AI options in one place.
claims.quote: Makers can see and adjust all available AI options for the app in one place instead of finding them scattered among all the other settings.

claims.claim: The roadmap moves admin settings from Environment > Settings to Copilot Hub > Power Apps.
claims.quote: In the Power Platform admin center, model-driven app AI settings are consolidated from Environment > Settings into Copilot Hub > Power Apps.

claims.claim: Generative pages are named as part of the planned consolidation.
claims.quote: This provides a central location for settings such as Generative pages, Copilot in apps, and the in-app AI skills.
